episodes.title: Odcinek 1
episodes.summary: In Kaliningrad, Polish spy Ewa goes undercover to gather critical information on a prominent Russian nuclear engineer.

episodes.title: Odcinek 2
episodes.summary: Posing as consul to the Polish embassy in Minsk, Ewa navigates a complex web of professional and personal relationships.

episodes.title: Odcinek 3
episodes.summary: Ewa helps a key target escape, while Lange works to keep his agents safe. In Riga, Tamara searches for answers.

episodes.title: Odcinek 4
episodes.summary: While discord rocks the consulate, Ewa closes in on the mole, and Lange fights for his remaining operatives in the field.

episodes.title: Odcinek 5
episodes.summary: Amid threats of a dirty bomb attack, Tamara closes in on Ewa's family, Skiner vows to protect Kaj in Krynki, and Ewa uncovers intel about Skopincev.
